`/home/user/Desktop/subdyn_eq_base.dat`, an OC3 monopile SubDyn model is provided. Additional initialization dependencies are pre-uploaded under `/home/user/Desktop` with relative structure preserved. Only initialization inputs are included; no answer/result artifacts are preloaded.

On this machine, the OpenFAST executable is `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/openfast` when working on `build_case.py`. Complete a deterministic prescribed-motion analysis from the command line using the OpenFAST 5.0 SubDyn standalone driver. 1. Write `/home/user/Desktop/build_case.py`. Create `/home/user/Desktop/earthquake_motion.txt` with samples from 0 to 60 s at 0.01 s. Each row must contain time followed by the 18 `InputsMod=2` values for one transition piece: six displacements/rotations, six velocities, and six accelerations. Keep all motion zero before 30 s. From 30 to 60 s, prescribe a smooth X-direction sinusoidal displacement pulse and its analytically consistent velocity and acceleration; use a `sin^4(pi*(t-30)/30)` envelope, 1 Hz carrier, and scale it so the peak absolute X acceleration is exactly `0.2g` with `g=9.80665 m/s^2`. Set all other components to zero. 2. Create `/home/user/Desktop/subdyn_eq.dat` from the supplied model, remove the unsupported trailing `ExtLdMod` line, retain native `ReactMYss`, and request native `Intf1TDXss`. Create `/home/user/Desktop/earthquake.dvr` with `InputsMod=2`, `InputsFile="earthquake_motion.txt"`, `NSteps=6000`, `TimeInterval=0.01`, one TP reference point at `(0,0,10)` m, and no applied loads. 3. Run `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/subdyn_driver earthquake.dvr`, retain `/home/user/Desktop/earthquake_sd.SD.out`, and save the console output as `/home/user/Desktop/earthquake_sd.log`; require normal termination. 4. Write `/home/user/Desktop/postprocess.py`. Over `30 <= t <= 60 s`, compute maximum absolute `Intf1TDXss` in m and maximum absolute `ReactMYss` converted from N-m to MN-m. Save `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as `peak_intf1_tdx_m,peak_reactmy_mnm`. Do not use GUI tools.
